description: A professional dermatologist-inspired routine for managing and maintaining healthy curly hair.
frequency: Daily, with additional deep conditioning weekly
estimated_time: 30-45 minutes per day, plus 1 hour for weekly treatments

morning_steps.action: Apply a light leave-in conditioner or texturizing spray to damp hair.
morning_steps.purpose: To detangle and define curls without weighing down the hair.

night_steps.action: Rinse out leave-in conditioner or texturizing spray with cool water.
night_steps.purpose: To seal the cuticle and prevent frizz, while also refreshing the hair for the next day.

weekly_steps.action: Apply a deep conditioning mask or leave-in treatment to moisturize and repair curly hair.

do: Use natural bristle brushes or wide-tooth combs when detangling.
Maintain consistent moisture levels by using appropriate products based on the humidity in your environment.
dont: Over-wash or use hot water, as this can strip natural oils from curly hair.
Apply heat styling tools directly to damp or wet hair.
common_mistakes: Failing to address dryness with regular moisturizing treatments.
Using the wrong type of shampoo or conditioner for curly hair, leading to excessive frizz and tangling.

expected_results.1_month: Healthier-looking curls with enhanced definition and elasticity.
expected_results.3_months: Significantly improved hair texture, reduced breakage, and overall satisfaction with the curl pattern.

expert_tips: Invest in high-quality tools that are suitable for curly hair to ensure gentle handling and better results.
Consider consulting a trichologist or dermatologist who specializes in curly hair care for personalized advice.
